ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 9, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Barbara A. Pollack, Chair  Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner
Chief Coleman, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Susan Wise, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55735  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, June 11, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55736  Recommendation to consider issues for website transitions between incoming and
  outgoing elected officials following elections, including ownership of website
  contents and City social media accounts.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55737  Recommendation to receive and file a report on the 2024 City of Long Beach
  Statement of Economic Interest Form 700 filers.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55738  Recommendation to receive and file, and if necessary, provide feedback to the
  draft executive summary of the establishment of the Ethics Commission and the
  Office of Ethics and Transparency that will serve both historical and educational
  purposes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55739  Recommendation to consider and discuss next steps in City policies review.

  Page 1 of 3
   ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 9, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55740  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming
  projects; and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-55741  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-55742  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
